selection_rule: FAILURE only, FAILYR <= 2025. Sort by FAILDATE and ID, round-robin over available years until 300. A coverage sample, not a representative sample.

field_notes.QBFASSET: Last reported assets before effective failure date, in thousands of US dollars.
field_notes.QBFDEP: Last reported deposits before effective failure date, in thousands of US dollars.
field_notes.FAILDATE: Effective failure date as recorded by FDIC; may be receivership date.
field_notes.ID: Dataset row key; not CERT or FIN.
